verdict.rationale: Qapita is a SaaS equity-management platform, so offering an interactive API reference is a fair question. Nothing in the pack documents a public API reference, an API explorer, or runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. The llms.txt file and the product pages describe only cap table, ESOP, valuation and fund-admin features.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
